Container.Name: Audplexus
Container.Overview:
Audplexus is a pure Go containerized app that authenticates with Audible, downloads audiobooks, removes DRM with FFmpeg, enriches metadata via Audnexus, and organizes books for Plex in an Author/Title/Title.m4b layout.
Latest release at time of this template update: v0.1.4. The container repository is set to the moving latest tag from GitHub Container Registry so new installs track the current published image.
Configuration: **WebUI Port** - Port for the web interface. Open this after the container starts to authenticate with Audible and manage downloads. Default is 8080. **Config Path** - Stores config.yaml, credentials.json, and the default SQLite database. **Audiobooks Path** - Final Plex library destination for organized audiobook files. **Downloads Path** - Temporary working directory for downloaded and processed files. **PUID / PGID** - Optional Unraid-style UID and GID overrides used when the container starts as root. **Take Ownership** - If set to true, the entrypoint will recursively chown /config, /audiobooks, and /downloads before dropping privileges. **Database Type** - sqlite by default. Change to postgres only if you will also provide a PostgreSQL DSN. **Output Format** - m4b by default, or set to mp3 if preferred. **Sync Schedule / Sync Mode** - Control automatic sync cadence and whether scheduled syncs run in quick or full mode.
Supported image tags include latest, v0, v0.1, and exact release tags such as v0.1.4 if you want to pin versions manually.
